decisions.text: When the system mode is idle, and the coin sensor changes to true, the coffee machine system shall reset the request timer, assign choice to the system mode.
decisions.guard: the_system_mode = idle /\ the_coin_sensor_antes = false /\ the_coin_sensor = true

decisions.text: When the system mode is choice, and the coin sensor is false, and the coin sensor was false, and the coffee request button changes to pressed, and the request timer is lower than or equal to 30.0, the coffee machine system shall reset the request timer, assign preparing weak coffee to the system mode.
decisions.guard: (((((the_system_mode = choice /\ the_coin_sensor = false) /\ the_coin_sensor_antes = -1) /\ the_coffee_request_button_antes != pressed) /\ the_coffee_request_button = pressed) /\ the_request_timer <= 30.0)

decisions.text: When the system mode is choice, and the coin sensor is false, and the coin sensor was false, and the coffee request button changes to pressed, and the request timer is greater than 30.0, the coffee machine system shall reset the request timer, assign preparing strong coffee to the system mode.
decisions.guard: the_system_mode = choice /\ the_coin_sensor = false /\ the_coin_sensor_antes = false /\ the_coffee_request_button_antes != pressed /\ the_coffee_request_button = pressed /\ the_request_timer > 30.0

decisions.text: When the system mode is preparing weak coffee, and the request timer is greater than or equal to 10.0, and the request timer is lower than or equal to 30.0, the coffee machine system shall assign idle to the system mode, assign weak to the coffee machine output.

When the system mode is preparing strong coffee, and the request timer is greater than or equal to 30.0, and the request timer is lower than or equal to 50.0, the coffee machine system shall assign idle to the system mode , assign strong to the coffee machine output.
